official_betting_policy: Do not issue model-derived official spread, moneyline, or total bets solely from the current game-market models. Track them prospectively against FanDuel lines while player-prop models continue as the official prop system.

shrunken_blend_v0.3.interpretation: On 2024 selection data, every nonzero model adjustment worsened the market benchmark. The rule therefore froze at zero adjustment before the untouched 2025 test.

next_step: For live 2026 games, record FanDuel opening/current/closing spread, total and moneyline when available; run independent and market-informed predictions in shadow; grade ATS/ML/O-U, calibration, CLV, and disagreement buckets before promoting any game-market model.
